capabilities: Browse and manage vault files with focus-zone shortcuts
Batch rename and batch create notes, folders, and canvases
Edit tags, properties, and YAML across selected notes
Move files by tag or YAML conditions
Customize the file context menu and Vim-style navigation
disambiguation: Not a focus timer; focus zones are shortcut lists for files and folders.
extras: Mobile support is experimental; cross-vault copy/paste is desktop only; batch tag, property, and YAML operations edit notes directly, so the README advises backups.
intentEvidence: A file manager for Obsidian that puts a file pane next to a focus pane.
problem: Finding and reorganizing files, tags, and properties in Obsidian requires repeated folder-tree navigation and separate manual edits.

relations.evidence: Items other plugins add for creating files (for example Excalidraw) appear in the right-click menu automatically.
It can also read .obsidian.vimrc (for example the file used by Vimrc Support)

summary: File manager with focus-zone shortcuts, tag and property managers, batch rename/create, YAML editing, and Vim-style keys.
